findings.description: move_card loads the card and verifies the actor is an editor only on `to_board_id`. It never checks the actor's role on the card's current board (card.board_id). An editor of their own board can pass any card id from a private board they cannot access and move it into their board. That reads the card and removes it from the victim board. NotFound vs Forbidden behaviour on the source board is also bypassed.
findings.suggestion: Call self._require_editor(card.board_id, actor_id) for the source board before the target check, and fail with the same NotFound/Forbidden semantics.
findings.title: Move checks editor rights only on the target board, not the source board

findings.description: archive_card detaches the card and sets archived=True but leaves card.position unchanged. There is no unarchive here, but any later restore or direct position use would collide with other cards. Minor compared to the other issues.
findings.suggestion: Reset position on archive, or re-insert on restore.
findings.title: Archived card keeps stale position, colliding on unarchive or later use
